answer: Like a subterranean mycelium weaving scarce nutrients into an iridescent opal of collective trust, decentralized consensus grounds each node in a web of transitive peer validations. Just as a solitary sparrow cannot counterfeit an entire flock's symbiotic haven, synthetic identities face superlinear attacker cost: forging valid mutual attestations scales quadratically, making mass impersonation economically ruinous.
